rules: Government attention requires delivered evidence with jurisdiction and confidence; hidden crimes are not telepathically known.
A delivered evidence reference may be consumed only once by government attention; compact hashes are retained solely to prevent replay.
Capture creates a conserved custody record for an existing person. It never creates, teleports, or removes a body.

Custody escape succeeds directly only when the current custodian is absent or physically unable to maintain custody; otherwise the prisoner must first create a physical opening through combat or injury. Release and escape change only current custody authority.
